MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 9
   C. 82
   D. 81

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 10
   C. 2
   D. 14

3. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 170
   C. 26
   D. 169

4. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

5. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 49
   C. 7
   D. 14

6. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

7. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 24
   C. 2
   D. 25

8. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 4

9. Solve for x: x + 5 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 16
   C. 12
   D. 11

10. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 22
   C. 121
   D. 11

11. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 1
   C. 57
   D. 15

12. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 13
   C. 1
   D. 12

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 9² = 9 × 9
3. 9² = 81
Final Answer: 81
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark
